hypothesis: On record boards with a graded scorer, an evolutionary program-search instrument (ShinkaEvolve 0.0.8, each proposal one harness turn on the seat) closes more of the gap to the best known bound than a chat-agent run on the same model, seat and wall budget, compared at matched fresh tokens. Units: two boards, circle packing (n = 26, maximise the sum of radii; validation only, its best known value is a reproduction target) and the first autocorrelation inequality (minimise C_1a; the improvement target, against 1.50274348670958). Both arms are scored by the same frozen board scorer; fresh tokens are uncached input plus cache writes plus output plus reasoning, as each harness meters them; cached tokens are reported beside them. Cost is tokens: a proxy in USD at the router catalog's published zai/glm-5.3 rate, read at report time and labelled as a proxy, beside the billed USD, which is 0 because the seat is flat-rate. Priors folded in, not re-run: M1 (search, G 0.34 on c1c) and M2 (test-time training, G 0.77 against a shuffled control at 0.69). Secondary reference only: the GLM-5.3 chat runs board-circle-packing-attempt-20261116a and record-first-autocorrelation-inequality-20261117a (the latter scored 1.5615). With one run per arm and board there is no interval: the result is the per-board table and both progress curves.

pins.instrument: Discovery board play, chat agents in OpenCode
pins.budget: the board play's own budget (hours 4, its roots and check)
hours 4 and a cap of 6000000 fresh tokens
pins.start: a naive valid construction (26 circles of radius 0.08; a constant step function, C = 2)

pins.model: the Kimi Code plan's default model
pins.instrument: the program-search arm's engine and knobs
pins.condition: run only while the seat's 7-day window has room after the GLM arms; reported as not run otherwise

interpretation.onQualitative: gapClosed is the share of the board's reference gap (its naive start's distance to the bar: 2.6359830849176076 - 2.08 for circle packing, 2 - 1.502743486709583 for the autocorrelation constant) that the arm's best graded construction had closed by the matched token point, clipped to [0, 1]; an arm with no graded construction there scores 0
interpretation.consequence: the matched token point of a board is the smaller of the two GLM-5.4 arms' total fresh tokens; each arm's best is read from its own progress curve (graded constructions against cumulative tokens), and the same table is reported at the arms' full budgets

interpretation.onQualitative: program search closes more of the gap than chat on both boards at matched tokens
interpretation.consequence: the instrument is worth a registered comparison on more record boards (at least eight) before any claim about instruments in general

interpretation.onQualitative: chat closes as much or more on both boards
interpretation.consequence: no program-search play is added to the default plays; the curves say whether more tokens would change that
reported per board; no pooled claim

interpretation.onQualitative: a construction is claimed to beat a bound
interpretation.consequence: the claim stands only after exact_check.py re-scores it in rational arithmetic and its exactly feasible value strictly beats the bound, with the open claims on that bound reported beside it
